attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a three-member MariaDB Galera cluster (MariaDB 10.1.48 + galera-3 from the official MariaDB xenial repo, since Ubuntu's native mariadb-server-10.0 build for this i386/Xenial image lacked wsrep support). Verified multi-master write propagation, availability with one node down (quorum preserved), and automatic resync (IST) when the node returns. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and full cluster recovery after each.
